name: Novikombank (NOVIKOM)
verdict: Rostec's subsidiary bank; on the back of FC Baltika's shirt (above the number) in 2026-27.
note: Rating note: Rostec's own site describes NOVIKOMBANK as its subsidiary bank (majority shareholder since 2016; EU Reg. 2022/581 confirms). Rostec is a Russian state corporation, and Russia's war in Ukraine goes on. Propose severe (state directly tied to ongoing severe abuses controls the sponsor through Rostec; mirrors the existing Gazprom/Aeroflot ratings).
